integrity: The exact formula is established by an analytic disjoint-bump and rank-nullity proof. No numerical certificate is needed. Self-review only; no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact approximation numbers are proved only for the canonical scalar inclusion C(K) to L-infinity(mu), with K compact Hausdorff and mu finite positive regular. No claim is made for general operators, weighted inclusions, finite p, vector-valued targets, entropy numbers, or ball measures of noncompactness.
title: Exact approximation-number profile of the canonical \(C(K)\)-to-\(L^\infty(\mu)\) inclusion
